name: SD: Ordering toward a target (generated by a system dynamics model)
description: A shop's stock, its orders on the way, and its purchasing budget, counted every day. The data is generated by a system dynamics model (the ground truth is in sd-orders/truth.model.json), so discovery can be checked exactly. Tests goal-seeking: orders follow the gap to a target stock. Tests a co-flow too: every unit ordered spends two dollars of the budget, which is topped back up toward a ceiling, so after a run of big orders the budget runs low and holds orders back.
